title: SetGRPO: Calibrating Grader-Induced Policy Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2610.36807v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Rubric-based reinforcement learning uses fine-grained grader feedback to train large language models on open-ended tasks, but grader randomness can alter GRPO updates in ways that score discrepancies alone cannot characterize. Because GRPO jointly normalizes rewards within each response group and combines the resulting training coefficients with response-level gradients, a scoring discrepancy can shift the coefficients of the entire group and induce policy-dependent update changes. Selective execution further affects the direction-reversal risk of retained updates. To address this, we propose Set-Valued Group Relative Policy Optimization (SetGRPO). It comprises three modules: (a) Joint Reward Set Calibration constructs a joint uncertainty set for the training coefficients; (b) Geometry-Guided Safe Recovery maps candidate coefficients into the current policy's local update geometry and determines the largest safe recovery ratio for each

translated_title: SetGRPO：校准评分器诱导的策略优化
translated_abstract: 基于评分标准的强化学习利用细粒度的评分器反馈来训练大语言模型完成开放式任务，但评分器的随机性可能会以仅凭分数差异无法刻画的方式改变GRPO的更新。由于GRPO在每个响应组内联合归一化奖励，并将由此得到的训练系数与响应级梯度相结合，一次评分差异可能会改变整组的系数，并引发依赖于策略的更新变化。选择性执行还会进一步影响被保留更新的方向反转风险。为解决这一问题，我们提出了集合值组相对策略优化。该方法包含三个模块：联合奖励集合校准为训练系数构建联合不确定性集合；几何引导的安全恢复将候选系数映射到当前策略的局部更新几何中，并为每个……确定最大的安全恢复比率
tldr: 提出SetGRPO方法，通过联合奖励集合校准和几何引导的安全恢复等模块来校准评分器随机性对GRPO更新的影响，从而提升基于评分反馈的强化学习训练的稳定性与安全性。
en_tdlr: SetGRPO is proposed to calibrate grader-induced randomness in GRPO updates by constructing joint uncertainty sets for training coefficients and applying geometry-guided safe recovery, improving the stability and safety of rubric-based reinforcement learning.
